prTitle: feat(python): add meeting room booking service
prDescription:
Adds a small meeting room booking service under `python/`.

- Conflict detection between a requested slot and existing bookings for the room, plus busy slots from the external calendar.
- Organizer e-mail domain allow-list (`ROOMBOOK_ALLOWED_DOMAINS`).
- SQLite-backed room search and booking storage.
- Confirmation of pending bookings and an e-mail notification to the organizer. Reminder e-mails are also sent to organizers 15 minutes before a booking starts.
- Dockerfile, `docs/CONFIG-PYTHON.md`, and a `python-ci` workflow running the unit tests on pull requests.
- The README moved to `docs/PYTHON-V9.md`.

Closes #88

findings.title: overlaps() treats back-to-back bookings as conflicting
findings.description: The docstring says half-open [start, end) intervals and that back-to-back bookings are fine, but `a_start <= b_end and b_start <= a_end` is true when one booking ends exactly when the next starts, so request_booking rejects a valid adjacent slot with 'room already booked'.
findings.suggestion_old: return a_start <= b_end and b_start <= a_end
findings.suggestion_new: return a_start < b_end and b_start < a_end

findings.title: rooms_by_capacity sorts largest first despite its docstring
